messages.text: Arteta says conscience clear over time at Man City

metadata.summary: Mikel Arteta has said he has a clear conscience over his former club Manchester City's serious breaches of financial rules.
metadata.content: Man City charges: Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta says he has clear conscience over his time at Etihad after serious breaches of financial rules | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Man City charges: Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta says he has clear conscience over his time at Etihad after serious breaches of financial rules Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta was asked about Manchester City being found to have arranged "sham contracts" with commercial partners to inflate revenues during a period in which he worked as Pep Guardiola's assistant; City have lodged an appeal and deny the chargers Friday 9 October 2026 21:41, UK Image: Mikel Arteta has been Arsenal boss since December 2019 Mikel Arteta has said he has a clear conscience over his former club Manchester City's serious breaches of financial rules. An independent commission found that between 2009/10 and 2017/18, City artificially inflated their revenue by £830m . The club have lodged an appeal and deny all wrongdoing. The investigation covered two years in which Arteta was working as assistant to manager Pep Guardiola but, in an otherwise guarded press conference, the Arsenal boss answered "yes" when asked if he had a clear conscience. Arteta, who this week signed a new four-year contract as Arsenal manager , faced a string of questions over the City verdict by journalists but repeatedly insisted he would not comment further until the outcome of City's appeal is known. messages.text: Wainwright opens Leicester account with Gloucester win in front of Prince Harry

metadata.summary: Wales back-rower Aaron Wainwright scored his first try for Leicester Tigers as they defeated Gloucester 38-31 in a forward-dominated contest in the Gallagher Prem watched by The Duke of Sussex, Prince Harry.
metadata.content: Gallagher Prem: Aaron Wainwright scores his first try for Leicester Tigers as they defeat Gloucester in front of Prince Harry | Rugby Union News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Gallagher Prem: Aaron Wainwright scores his first try for Leicester Tigers as they defeat Gloucester in front of Prince Harry Aaron Wainwright scores his first try for Leicester Tigers as they defeat Gloucester in high-scoring encounter at Mattioli Woods Welford Road Stadium; The Duke of Sussex, Prince Harry, was spotted in the stands Friday 9 October 2026 22:44, UK Image: Leicester's Aaron Wainwright scored his first try for the Tigers Wales back-rower Aaron Wainwright scored his first try for Leicester Tigers as they defeated Gloucester 38-31 in a forward-dominated contest in the Gallagher Prem watched by The Duke of Sussex, Prince Harry. The hosts found themselves 14-0 down after just 10 minutes at Mattioli Woods Welford Road, but a sustained period of dominance led to them scoring 31 unanswered points that put them well on the way to their second straight win. For the Cherry and Whites, this was a first league loss of the season as they fell short in a match that saw eight of the nine tries scored by forwards. messages.text: Forrest holds halfway lead at Open de Espana

metadata.summary: Scotland's Grant Forrest continued his good record at the Open de Espana to take a one-stroke lead into the weekend.
metadata.content: Open de Espana: Grant Forrest continues good record to take one-stroke lead into the weekend in Madrid | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Open de Espana: Grant Forrest continues good record to take one-stroke lead into the weekend in Madrid Scotland's Grant Forrest nudged ahead of the pack to lead the Open de Espana after two rounds; compatriot Connor Syme shares second place with Switzerland's Joel Girrbach in Madrid; Spain's Eugenio Chacarra and Joe Dean of England are a shot further back Friday 9 October 2026 20:27, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from day two of the Open de Espana at Club de Campo Villa de Madrid Scotland's Grant Forrest continued his good record at the Open de Espana to take a one-stroke lead into the weekend. Forrest, who was at five-under-par alongside fellow Scotsman Conner Syme and Spain's Eugenio Chacarra at the end of Thursday's play, carded a four-under second-round 67 to move to nine under and open a one-stroke lead at Club de Campo Villa de Madrid. Syme shot a second-round 68 and sits in joint-second place with Switzerland's Joel Girrbach, who rolled in five consecutive birdies from the fourth hole on the way to his 66. messages.text: Musical Times stays unbeaten in Fillies' Mile at Newmarket

metadata.summary: Musical Times overcame traffic problems to maintain her unbeaten record in the bet365 Fillies' Mile at Newmarket.
metadata.content: Newmarket: Musical Times stays unbeaten with Fillies' Mile victory for Charlie Appleby with William Buick on board | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Newmarket: Musical Times stays unbeaten with Fillies' Mile victory for Charlie Appleby with William Buick on board Musical Times confirmed her Classic prospects with a dramatic success in the Group One Fillies' Mile at Newmarket, overcoming a host of traffic problems to land her first success at the top level Friday 9 October 2026 16:36, UK Image: Musical Times, ridden by William Buick, on the way to winning the bet365 Fillies' Mile at Newmarket Musical Times overcame traffic problems to maintain her unbeaten record in the bet365 Fillies' Mile at Newmarket. Charlie Appleby's youngster had looked a top-class prospect in winning her first two starts on the July Course and at Yarmouth, and completed her hat-trick with facile victory in the May Hill Stakes at Doncaster last month. Subsequent 1000 Guineas heroine Desert Flower completed the May Hill-Fillies' Mile double two years ago for Appleby and William Buick and Musical Times was the 4/9 favourite to follow suit. It was not entirely straightforward for odds-on backers, with Buick struggling to find a gap, but once the split did come she quickly went through the gears to beat Aidan O'Brien's Haven by a length.
